Service 02 • Academics & Careers

Education Consultant & Placement in Jharkhand & West Bengal

Empowering students and job seekers with authentic admission guidance, personalized career counselling, and verified job placement support.

From Campus to Career

Your Pathway to Top Universities & Corporate Careers

Choosing the right academic course and securing genuine job opportunities shouldn't be left to guesswork. GB Group works directly with accredited colleges, universities, and corporate recruiters to ensure seamless admissions and fruitful career placements for students in Jharkhand and West Bengal.

100% Genuine Guidance: Transparent fees, recognized degrees, and direct admission counselling.
Corporate Placement Support: Resume preparation, interview training, and placement drives.

1. Course & College Guidance

Evaluating students and counselling them to pick the right course:

  • Engineering: B.Tech, M.Tech, Polytechnic & Diploma (CSE, ME, Civil, EE).
  • Management: MBA, PGDM, BBA, B.Com (Finance, Marketing, HR, Analytics).
  • IT & Computer Apps: BCA, MCA, Data Science, Cloud Computing.
  • Healthcare: B.Pharma, D.Pharma, B.Sc Nursing, Paramedical.
  • Law & Design: BA LLB, BBA LLB, Hotel Management, Media.

2. Admission Help

Removing documentation hassle and confusion:

  • Guidance for state & national entrance tests and counselling rounds.
  • Application form filling, document verification, and eligibility checks.
  • Direct admission coordination in UGC, AICTE, and PCI-approved institutions.
  • Education loan assistance and scholarship guidance.

3. Career Counselling

Personalized mentoring for actionable career roadmaps:

  • One-on-one sessions analyzing strengths and academic performance.
  • Insights into high-growth industry sectors and in-demand future skills.
  • Overcoming confusion between multiple career paths or course options.

4. Job Placement Support

Bridging fresh graduates and skilled professionals with employers:

  • Corporate recruitment tie-ups across IT, Manufacturing, Retail, and BFSI.
  • Professional resume formatting and LinkedIn profile enhancement.
  • Mock interviews, group discussion (GD) coaching, and soft skills training.
  • Direct referral to active hiring openings across Kolkata, Ranchi, and pan-India.
